## Summary

I extended the existing business-day rule in `RegistrationDates` to also skip public holidays.

**`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RegistrationDates.java`**
- Added a `HOLIDAYS` set with the five fixed dates (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28).
- Updated the `toBusinessDay` roll-forward loop to continue past any date that is a weekend **or** a listed holiday, so it lands on the next non-holiday business day.
- Extracted the weekend check into a small `isWeekend` helper to keep the loop condition readable.

This kept the logic in the single place both `ResolveRegistrationDate` and `EnsureDailyLimit` already share, so no rule was duplicated. `mvnw test` reports `BUILD SUCCESS` with all tests green.

The acceptance test asserts the black-box invariant (default registration date is never a Saturday/Sunday) since the holiday calendar and server clock can't be driven externally, but the pinned `HOLIDAYS` set in the code now matches the one in `AcceptanceBase`.
